basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old fantasy enthusiast living in Seattle, WA. By day, I work as a software developer for a mid-sized tech company, but by night, I'm a dedicated Dungeon Master who loves weaving intricate storylines for my friends. I have a keen interest in fitness and try to hit the gym at least five times a week. When I'm not coding or planning campaigns, I enjoy exploring new music and watching quirky YouTube creators like Brian David Gilbert. I'm currently in a long-term relationship with my college sweetheart. I typically browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in computer science, having graduated with a degree from a reputed university. My interest in Dungeons & Dragons began in college, where I started as a player before taking on the Dungeon Master role. I am self-taught in world-building and narrative design, and I frequently draw inspiration from a variety of fantasy literature and games.
